Artificial Intelligence (AI) enables machines to perform tasks that normally need human intelligence, like learning and decision-making.

Machine Learning is a branch of AI where computers learn patterns from data and improve without being explicitly programmed.
Machine Learning AI ki branch hai jisme computer data se patterns seekhta hai aur bina explicit programming ke behtar hota jata hai.
Deep Learning is a part of Machine Learning that uses multi-layer neural networks to learn complex patterns.
Deep Learning, Machine Learning ka hissa hai jisme multi-layer neural networks se complex patterns seekhe jate hain.
NLP (Natural Language Processing) helps computers understand, interpret and generate human language.
NLP (Natural Language Processing) computers ko insani bhasha samajhne aur generate karne me madad karta hai.
A chatbot is a program that talks with users through text or voice. A rule-based chatbot replies using predefined patterns and responses.
